sections.title: Detailed Brief Overview
rows: Geographical and political study of **India's Neighboring Countries** sharing land and maritime borders.
Relevant from historical boundaries (**McMahon Line, Radcliffe Line**) to modern geopolitical treaties and agreements.
South Asia and Southeast Asia region bordering the **Indian subcontinent**.
Total **9 neighboring countries** (7 land borders and 2 maritime neighbors - Sri Lanka and Maldives).
Crucial scoring section for **UPSSSC PET General Awareness** covering capitals, currencies, parliaments, and borders.
**Bangladesh** shares the longest land border with India; **Afghanistan** shares the shortest land border.
Direct factual questions asked on **borders, currencies, national symbols, and bilateral lines**.
India follows the **'Neighbourhood First'** policy for diplomatic and strategic cooperation in South Asia.

items.title: Land Border Sharing Countries with **Mnemonic: ' बचपन में एमबीए किया '** (Bachan Mein MBA Kiya)
items.content:
• **Ba** - Bangladesh (**4096.7 km** - Longest border)
• **Chpan** - China (**3488 km**)
• **Me** - Pakistan (**3323 km**)
• **M** - Nepal (**1751 km**)
• **B** - Myanmar (**1643 km**)
• **A** - Bhutan (**699 km**)
• **A** - Afghanistan (**106 km** - Shortest border)
• **Note:** This sequence is arranged in descending order of border length with India.

items.title: Currencies of Neighboring Countries with **Mnemonic: ' Rupee Neighbors '**
items.content:
• Countries using **Rupee / Rupee equivalent**: Pakistan (Pakistani Rupee), Nepal (Nepalese Rupee), Sri Lanka (Sri Lankan Rupee), Maldives (Rufiyaa), Mauritius (Mauritian Rupee - broader region).
• Countries with distinct currencies: **China** (Yuan / Renminbi), **Bangladesh** (Taka), **Bhutan** (Ngultrum), **Myanmar** (Kyat), **Afghanistan** (Afghani).
• **Exam Tip:** Frequently asked in UPSSSC PET matching questions.

items.title: Parliaments of Neighboring Countries
items.content:
• **India**: Parliament (Sansad)
• **Pakistan**: Majlis-e-Shoora (National Assembly)
• **China**: National People's Congress (NPC)
• **Nepal**: Federal Parliament (Pratinidhi Sabha & Rashtriya Sabha)
• **Bhutan**: Tshogdu (Parliament with National Council & National Assembly)
• **Bangladesh**: Jatiya Sangsad
• **Myanmar**: Pyidaungsu Hluttaw
• **Afghanistan**: Shura (Currently defunct under Taliban rule)

items.title: Borders and Boundary Lines
items.content:
• **Radcliffe Line**: Boundary between India and **Pakistan** (drawn in **1947** by Sir Cyril Radcliffe).
• **McMahon Line**: Boundary between India (Arunachal Pradesh) and **China** (drawn in **1914** at Shimla Convention).
• **Durand Line**: Boundary between Pakistan and **Afghanistan** (also touches Pakistan-administered regions).
• **Zero Line**: Boundary separating India and **Bangladesh** (Tripura sector).

items.title: Maritime Neighbors of India
items.content:
• **Sri Lanka**: Separated from India by the **Palk Strait** and **Gulf of Mannar**.
• **Maldives**: Located to the south of the Lakshadweep islands in the Indian Ocean, separated by the **Eight Degree Channel**.
• Both maritime neighbors are critical for India's **Indian Ocean Security** and trade routes.

items.definition: Use mnemonic **' ATM on PC '** -> **A**ssam, **T**ripura, **M**eghalaya, **M**izoram, **P**aschim Banga (West Bengal).
Use mnemonic **' UBI BN '** -> **U**ttar Pradesh, **B**ihar, **U**ttarakhand, **B**engal (West Bengal), **N**ikkam (Sikkim).
Use mnemonic **' JUA SI '** -> **J**ammu & Kashmir / Ladakh, **U**ttarakhand, **A**runachal Pradesh, **S**ikkim, **H**imachal Pradesh (Himachal).
Use mnemonic **' PBRGJ '** -> **P**unjab, **B**ihar (No - ignore), **R**ajasthan, **G**ujarat, **J**ammu & Kashmir / Ladakh.
Remember **' P N S '** -> **P**akistan, **N**epal, **S**ri Lanka all use 'Rupee' as their official currency name.
Nepal has **Mount Everest** (world highest), Pakistan has **K2** (Godwin-Austen, second highest globally).
Students often think **China** shares the longest border with India due to its size. **Correct Fact:** **Bangladesh** shares the longest border (**4096.7 km**).
Students assume Afghanistan does not touch India directly today. **Correct Fact:** Afghanistan shares a **106 km** border with India in Pakistan-Occupied Kashmir (POK).
Students confuse Thimphu with Paro. **Correct Fact:** **Thimphu** is the capital and largest city of Bhutan.
Students sometimes include Sri Lanka in land-border sharing countries. **Correct Fact:** Sri Lanka is exclusively a **maritime neighbor** separated by the Palk Strait.
Myanmar was formerly known as **Burma**, renamed officially in **1989**. Capital shifted from Yangon to **Naypyidaw** in **2006**.
India shares land borders with **7 countries** and maritime borders with **2 countries** (Total 9).
**Bangladesh** shares the longest international border with India measuring **4096.7 km**.
**Afghanistan** shares the shortest land border with India measuring **106 km**.
Demarcates the boundary between India and **Pakistan** (and Bangladesh formerly East Pakistan).
Demarcates the boundary between India (Arunachal Pradesh) and **China**.
Demarcates the boundary between **Pakistan and Afghanistan**.
A strait between the Tamil Nadu state of India and the Mannar district of the Northern Province of **Sri Lanka**.
Separates the **Maldives** islands from the Minicoy island of India.
**Nepal and Bhutan** are landlocked Himalayan countries bordered by India and China.
Regional organization including India and neighboring countries like Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka.

upscNotes.content: In UPSSSC PET, questions on neighboring countries frequently ask for exact capitals, currencies, and bordering Indian states. Memorize the 'Bachan Mein MBA Kiya' mnemonic thoroughly.
Examiners often set traps by interchanging the border lengths of China and Pakistan. Always remember China is second longest (3488 km) and Pakistan is third longest (3323 km).
Keep a sharp eye on recent name changes, capital relocations (like Myanmar's Naypyidaw), and newly formed constitutional names of neighboring parliaments.
Do not confuse the Palk Strait with a land route; it is a water body separating India and Sri Lanka.

keyTakeaways: India shares land borders with 7 nations and maritime borders with 2 nations.
Bangladesh has the longest border (4096.7 km); Afghanistan has the shortest (106 km).
Radcliffe Line separates India-Pakistan; McMahon Line separates India-China.
Nepal and Bhutan are landlocked nations in the Himalayas.
Sri Lanka and Maldives are key maritime neighbors in the Indian Ocean.
Currencies and capitals of all 9 neighboring countries are high-yield questions for UPSSSC PET.
